description: v8.27.0 Cisco tag-evidence review: searches that named Cisco sourcetypes or fields no published add-on produces now use the documented names. Detection intent of every identifier is unchanged.

changes.reason: Same Duo authentication detections: field names aligned to the Duo Admin API authentication log schema (result, factor, user.name, access_device.ip, application.name, trusted_endpoint_status) as ingested by the Cisco Security Cloud add-on
Same Cisco Unified CM call-quality and registration detections: cisco:ucm:cdr, cisco:ucm:cmr and cisco:ucm:syslog replaced by the documented cucm_cdr, cucm_cmr and cisco:cucm:syslog sourcetypes

Same detections: undocumented Cisco sourcetypes renamed to the ones the Cisco add-ons produce (cisco:esa:mail to cisco:esa:textmail, umbrella:dns to cisco:umbrella:dns, cisco:anyconnect to cisco_anyconnect:vpn, duo:authentication to cisco:duo:authentication)
